observations.body: A community works and shines while Paul is poured out. So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling. In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

payload.posture: Read Philippians 2:12–18 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a community works and shines while Paul is poured out. So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling. In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
